description: Implementation of platform-specific MIME type utility functions for macOS and iOS, including methods to get MIME type from file extension, get preferred extension from MIME type, and retrieve extensions for a MIME type, using system APIs like Uniform Type Identifiers and CoreServices.

methods.name: GetPlatformMimeTypeFromExtension
methods.description: Retrieves the MIME type for a given file extension using system APIs, with fallback for older OS versions.

methods.name: GetPlatformPreferredExtensionForMimeType
methods.description: Retrieves the preferred file extension for a given MIME type using system APIs, with fallback for older OS versions.

methods.name: GetPlatformExtensionsForMimeType
methods.description: Retrieves all file extensions associated with a MIME type, using system APIs and fallback mechanisms.
